# asc_group (Data Source)

Reads a group by name from the configured tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "asc_group" "example" {
  name = "platform"
}

output "example_group_member_names" {
  value = [for member in data.asc_group.example.members : member.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the group.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the group.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the group.
- `members` (Attributes List) Users and API clients that belong to the group, sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))
- `urn` (String) Resource identifier of the group.

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the member is enabled.
- `name` (String) Username or API client name of the member.
- `type` (String) Whether the member is a user or an API client.
